title: Decision: Attach events_tx after construction, not in constructor
description:
Store construction leaves events_tx as None (line 131, 141), then daemon calls set_events_tx after (line 151). This is non-obvious but correct:

1. Avoids circular dependencies: Store doesn't need to know about event channel at construction
2. Enables testing with in-memory stores that have None (no events needed in unit tests)
3. Lazy initialization is safe because daemon sets it before serving any requests
4. Sub-stores receive references and call .send() after writes (line 48-52)
5. Comment at line 17-20 documents the lifecycle explicitly

This breaks the 'all initialization in constructor' pattern but is justified by the architectural constraint: the broadcast channel is created in main.rs, not in the Store.
